### 2024 Election Results and the 2024 District Map

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# load cleaned data
sov_clean <- read_csv("data/g24_sov_by_g24_svprec.csv")

# build two-party congressional totals per precinct
sov_cong <- sov_clean |>
  mutate(
    DEM = rowSums(across(starts_with("CNGDEM")), na.rm = TRUE),
    REP = rowSums(across(starts_with("CNGREP")), na.rm = TRUE),
    TOTAL = DEM + REP
  ) |>
  filter(TOTAL > 0)
```

```{r}
district_votes <- sov_cong |>
  group_by(CDDIST) |>
  summarize(
    DEM = sum(DEM),
    REP = sum(REP)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    TOTAL = DEM + REP,
    DEM_SHARE = DEM / TOTAL
  )
```

```{r}
mean_median <- mean(district_votes$DEM_SHARE) - median(district_votes$DEM_SHARE)
mean_median
```

```{r}
district_votes <- district_votes |>
  mutate(
    winner = if_else(DEM > REP, "DEM", "REP"),
    wasted_D = if_else(winner == "DEM", DEM - (TOTAL/2 + 1), DEM),
    wasted_R = if_else(winner == "REP", REP - (TOTAL/2 + 1), REP)
  )

total_two_party <- sum(district_votes$TOTAL)

eff_gap <- (sum(district_votes$wasted_D) - sum(district_votes$wasted_R)) /
           total_two_party

eff_gap
```
